html_source: As Milly grew up, and especially after she left home, Bloom had to concentrate on a domestic problem that had always plagued him – what to do with our wives? He tried many things from games to music. He decided to shore up her deficient education but without success. He found, finally, that he could manage her only by indirect suggestion implying self-interest.
